Ao contrario do que muitos pensam não é jogo de bater carros. Se trata do mais sofisticado simulador de veiculos atualmente disponivel para uso domestico. Praticamente quase todos componentes de um veiculo é simulado em tempo real chegando ao detalhe por exemplo de reproduzir a queima do oleo do motor bem como o movimento do fluido dentro do bloco do motor. As informações geradas para o forcefeedback de volantes transformam simuladores famosos ditos realistas em brincadeira de criança. A criacao da opcao multiplayer e a importacao de pistas famosas de outros simuladores tambem acrescentou mais valor a plataforma do Beam NG. Recomendo fortemente a todos aqueles que buscam simulação de direcao em altissimo nivel de qualidade.

BeamNG.drive stands out as a masterpiece in the gaming world because of its revolutionary soft-body physics engine. Unlike traditional racing games that rely on pre-baked animations for crashes, this simulator calculates the physical behavior of every vehicle component in real time. This means that a collision at fifty miles per hour bends steel, shatters glass, and twists frames with absolute realism, making every driving error feel impactful and visually spectacular.
Beyond its industry-leading destruction, the game provides a deeply rewarding driving simulation. The meticulous attention to weight distribution, tire grip, and suspension geometry creates an authentic experience that rivals dedicated racing simulators. Whether you are navigating a high-speed track, crawling over treacherous rocks, or delivering cargo in a heavy semi-truck, the vehicle handling feels incredibly organic and responsive.
Furthermore, its vast open-ended sandbox nature grants players ultimate freedom. With a massive library of official and community-made vehicles, extensive tuning options, and an active modding scene, the possibilities are virtually limitless. BeamNG.drive is not just a game about crashing cars; it is the ultimate playground for automotive enthusiasts, offering unparalleled realism, depth, and creative freedom.
